REVERSIBLE OBSERVER COVERS, ONE-TRACE CURRENT TESTS, AND A RATE CEILING
Solo derivation and construction, 31 October 2026.

1. CONTRACT

X is a stationary discrete-time Markov chain on a standard-Borel space,
with invariant law pi and transition P. All variables are EVEN under the
specified reversal. Write Gamma(dx,dy)=pi(dx)P(x,dy), Gamma^T(dx,dy)=
Gamma(dy,dx), P* for the stationary reverse kernel, and

                         e(P)=D(Gamma||Gamma^T).

This is nats per discrete step. It is not device heat without a supplied
thermodynamic model. Reducibility and periodicity are permitted; no hidden
state count, mixing time, spectral gap or independent repeats are supplied.
Hidden stationary initialization is an ASSUMPTION and an acquisition cost.
It cannot be verified solely by running the evaluator on an observed trace.

The finite-valued deterministic observation Y_t=a(X_t) is available at each
step. The core binary evaluator uses only that record. Power computations
below use a fully specified mathematical source; those parameters are NOT
inputs to the null test. A future continuous-time claim must charge the
sampling interval and its physical implementation separately.

2. WHICH DETERMINISTIC OBSERVER UPDATES PRESERVE EQUILIBRIUM?

For every observed label a let C_a be a finite set of the same size m,
and let T_ab:C_a->C_b be bijections satisfying

                         T_ba=T_ab^{-1}.                    (1)

In particular T_aa is an involution. Start C_0 uniformly on the fiber,
independently of X, and update C_{t+1}=T_{Y_t,Y_{t+1}} C_t. The lifted
chain on (x,c) has kernel

          P~((x,c),d(y,d))=P(x,dy)1_{d=T_ab(c)}.

Its stationary law is pi(dx)/m: incoming transport maps a uniform fiber
to a uniform fiber for every x->y. The reverse of the lifted edge is
exactly the lift of the reverse microscopic edge, by (1). Consequently

       P reversible => P~ reversible,       e(P~)=e(P).    (2)

For the entropy identity each microscopic directed edge is copied m times,
each with flow divided by m and with exactly the original forward/reverse
Radon-Nikodym ratio. This also proves the extended-value identity. Averaging
P~ with its stationary reverse is the lift of P_s=(P+P*)/2.

A function g((x,c),(y,d)) that depends only on the observed labels/fibers
is available computationally. If |g|<=1 and g(z,z')=-g(z',z), its sum is

source_excerpts.text:
PREDICTIVE-FLOW DUALS ON ONE DEPENDENT STATIONARY RECORD
Solo derivation, 31 October 2026. This is a mathematical proof, not a
physical experiment or a claim of historical priority.

1. THE ACQUISITION QUESTION

The preceding outputs/predictive_flow/PROOF.txt constructs complete finite
LP outer tests for a reversible hidden realization of a finite observed
word law. Its iid validation and count experiments have their own contracts.
Here the supplied sample is ONE consecutive stationary record. No mixing
time, spectral gap, hidden-state count, reset, or independent replicas are
assumed. Stationary hidden initialization is still required. It is not
established by calling a simulation stationary, or by an uncharged burn-in.

Hidden states are standard Borel; time is discrete and reversal is all-even.
P is a stationary Markov kernel with invariant probability pi. Observations
Y_t=a(X_t) lie in a finite alphabet of size s. The reversible null is P=P*.
All statements below permit reducibility and periodicity.

Conclusion. Every finite rational dual of the preceding LP, verified on
EVERY flow column, supplies a uniform no-mixing tail test on this record.
It also supplies a conservative confidence lower bound on e(P). A fixed
countable collection of such certificates yields an anytime equilibrium
test that is complete against stationary ERGODIC observed alternatives
with no reversible hidden realization. Computation and certificate selection
costs are explicit below; completeness supplies no useful universal budget.

2. PRECISE FINITE CERTIFICATE INTERFACE

Fix depth L>=1, mesh h=1/k, and the prefix-simplex grid used by
predictive_flow/flow_grid.py. A node i consists of a label and two leaf
distributions, each with k integer units on words of length L. Let r^q_w(i)
be the prefix probabilities, q in {+,-}; r_empty=1. A descriptor d=(q,b,w,tau)
has |w|<L and tau in {-1,+1}. For ordered nodes define

 a_d(i,j)=tau[1_{a(j)=b}r^q_w(j)-r^q_{bw}(i)]-h.          (D1)

The certificate consists of rational y_{i,d}<=0, rational word coefficients
c_v for |v|=2L+1, and rational z. Let

 F_v(i)=1_{a(i)=v_L} r^-_{reverse(v_0...v_{L-1})}(i)
                           r^+_{v_{L+1}...v_{2L}}(i),
 c(i)=sum_v c_v F_v(i),
 A(i,j)=c(i)+sum_d y_{i,d}a_d(i,j).

The receiver must verify exactly, for ALL node pairs including diagonals,

                  z+[A(i,j)+A(j,i)]/2 <= 0.

FROM EQUILIBRIUM TESTS TO REALISED HIDDEN PATH ENTROPY
Solo proof, 31 October 2026. Historical priority unestablished.

1. A DIFFERENT TARGET, WITH AN EXPLICIT REASON

The uniformly honest stationary MEAN-rate endpoint is subject to the
metastable ceiling in PROOF.txt. This file does not withdraw that result.
Its target is the random entropy produced on the PARTICULAR realised
hidden trajectory, including its stationary system-entropy boundary term:

 Sigma_N=log[dP_{0:N}/dP^R_{0:N}](X_{0:N}).               (P1)

P is stationary all-even hidden Markov dynamics; P^R denotes its stationary
path law reversed in time. In discrete time,

 Sigma_N=sum_{t<N}log[dGamma/dGamma^T](X_t,X_{t+1}).

Its expectation is N e(P), but its value is NOT that expectation. In a
stationary finite CTMC over duration T, its expectation is T sigma; local
detailed balance is needed to interpret it as physical total entropy.
It is not medium heat alone when system-boundary entropy is nonzero.

Sigma can be negative. A confidence LOWER endpoint must retain negative
values, or abstain when it fails to certify positivity. Clamping it to
zero would be false: a one-step weakly driven cycle has negative Sigma
with probability arbitrarily close to one half.

        standard-Borel Markov model of these observations. (P2)

                     E_P[e^{-Sigma_N/2} E]<=1,            (P3)

and consequently

        Pr_P{Sigma_N >= 2 log(alpha E)} >= 1-alpha.        (P4)

The inference algorithm does not need P or pi to evaluate the right side.
Its physical assumptions and the fixed/charged selection of E still matter.
